subject.name: English
subject.textbook: NCERT First Flight (19) + Footprints Without Feet (9) – English L&L 184
subject.examPattern: CBSE Board exam, 3 h, 80 theory + 20 internal assessment; 'no change in question paper design for 2026-27'. Two board exams: Phase 1 (Feb, mandatory) + Phase 2 (May, optional improvement in up to 3 subjects). Paper: 11 questions – A Reading 20 (2 passages, 17 sub-items); B Grammar 10 (10 of 12 items) + Writing 10 (formal letter, analytical paragraph); C Literature 40 (2 extracts, First Flight 4 of 5 SA, Footprints 2 of 3 SA, 2 long answers ×6). IA includes Listening & Speaking.
